verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِدَاوُدَ. مَزْمُورٌ. تَسْبِيحَةٌ يَقُومُ ٱللهُ. يَتَبَدَّدُ أَعْدَاؤُهُ وَيَهْرُبُ مُبْغِضُوهُ مِنْ أَمَامِ وَجْهِهِ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [or] Song of David. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמֹ֥ור שִֽׁיר׃ יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אֹויְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

verses.ar: كَمَا يُذْرَى ٱلدُّخَانُ تُذْرِيهِمْ. كَمَا يَذُوبُ ٱلشَّمَعُ قُدَّامَ ٱلنَّارِ يَبِيدُ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: As smoke is driven away, [so] drive [them] away: as wax melteth before the fire, [so] let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.he: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דֹּ֭ונַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: وَٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَفْرَحُونَ. يَبْتَهِجُونَ أَمَامَ ٱللهِ وَيَطْفِرُونَ فَرَحًا.
verses.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.he: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃

verses.ar: غَنُّوا لِلهِ. رَنِّمُوا لِٱسْمِهِ. أَعِدُّوا طَرِيقًا لِلرَّاكِبِ فِي ٱلْقِفَارِ بِٱسْمِهِ يَاهْ، وَٱهْتِفُوا أَمَامَهُ.
verses.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.
verses.web: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
verses.he: שִׁ֤ירוּ ׀ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מֹ֥ו סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבֹות בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמֹ֗ו וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

verses.ar: أَبُو ٱلْيَتَامَى وَقَاضِي ٱلْأَرَامِلِ، ٱللهُ فِي مَسْكِنِ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, [is] God in his holy habitation.
verses.web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.he: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תֹומִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנֹ֑ות אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְעֹ֥ון קָדְשֹֽׁו׃

verses.ar: ٱللهُ مُسْكِنُ ٱلْمُتَوَحِّدِينَ فِي بَيْتٍ. مُخْرِجُ ٱلْأَسْرَى إِلَى فَلَاحٍ. إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُتَمَرِّدُونَ يَسْكُنُونَ ٱلرَّمْضَاءَ.
verses.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry [land].
verses.web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ מֹ֘ושִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים ׀ בַּ֗יְתָה מֹוצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכֹּושָׁרֹ֑ות אַ֥ךְ סֹ֝ורֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃

verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، عِنْدَ خُرُوجِكَ أَمَامَ شَعْبِكَ، عِنْدَ صُعُودِكَ فِي ٱلْقَفْرِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.web: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
verses.he: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימֹ֣ון סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱرْتَعَدَتِ. ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ أَيْضًا قَطَرَتْ أَمَامَ وَجْهِ ٱللهِ. سِينَا نَفْسُهُ مِنْ وَجْهِ ٱللهِ إِلَهِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: [even] Sinai itself [was moved] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.he: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה ׀ אַף־שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: مَطَرًا غَزِيرًا نَضَحْتَ يَا ٱللهُ. مِيرَاثُكَ وَهُوَ مُعْيٍ أَنْتَ أَصْلَحْتَهُ.
verses.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
verses.he: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבֹות תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֹֽונַנְתּֽ͏ָהּ׃

verses.ar: قَطِيعُكَ سَكَنَ فِيهِ. هَيَّأْتَ بِجُودِكَ لِلْمَسَاكِينِ يَا ٱللهُ.
verses.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
verses.he: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטֹובָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يُعْطِي كَلِمَةً. ٱلْمُبَشِّرَاتُ بِهَا جُنْدٌ كَثِيرٌ:
verses.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great [was] the company of those that published [it].
verses.web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
verses.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂרֹ֗ות צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃

verses.ar: «مُلُوكُ جُيُوشٍ يَهْرُبُونَ يَهْرُبُونَ، ٱلْمُلَازِمَةُ ٱلْبَيْتَ تَقْسِمُ ٱلْغَنَائِمَ.
verses.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.web: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
verses.he: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאֹות יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱضْطَجَعْتُمْ بَيْنَ ٱلْحَظَائِرِ فَأَجْنِحَةُ حَمَامَةٍ مُغَشَّاةٌ بِفِضَّةٍ وَرِيشُهَا بِصُفْرَةِ ٱلذَّهَبِ».
verses.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, [yet shall ye be as] the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.web: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
verses.he: אִֽם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י יֹ֭ונָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרֹותֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَمَا شَتَّتَ ٱلْقَدِيرُ مُلُوكًا فِيهَا، أَثْلَجَتْ فِي صَلْمُونَ.
verses.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was [white] as snow in Salmon.
verses.web: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
verses.he: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֹֽון׃

verses.ar: جَبَلُ ٱللهِ، جَبَلُ بَاشَانَ. جَبَلُ أَسْنِمَةٍ، جَبَلُ بَاشَانَ.
verses.kjv: The hill of God [is as] the hill of Bashan; an high hill [as] the hill of Bashan.
verses.web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
verses.he: הַר־אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־בָּשָֽׁן׃

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا أَيَّتُهَا ٱلْجِبَالُ ٱلْمُسَنَّمَةُ تَرْصُدْنَ ٱلْجَبَلَ ٱلَّذِي ٱشْتَهَاهُ ٱللهُ لِسَكَنِهِ؟ بَلِ ٱلرَّبُّ يَسْكُنُ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? [this is] the hill [which] God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell [in it] for ever.
verses.web: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
verses.he: לָ֤מָּה ׀ תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתֹּ֑ו אַף־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃

verses.ar: مَرْكَبَاتُ ٱللهِ رِبْوَاتٌ، أُلُوفٌ مُكَرَّرَةٌ. ٱلرَّبُّ فِيهَا. سِينَا فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ.
verses.kjv: The chariots of God [are] twenty thousand, [even] thousands of angels: the Lord [is] among them, [as in] Sinai, in the holy [place].
verses.web: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
verses.he: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: صَعِدْتَ إِلَى ٱلْعَلَاءِ. سَبَيْتَ سَبْيًا. قَبِلْتَ عَطَايَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ، وَأَيْضًا ٱلْمُتَمَرِّدِينَ لِلسَّكَنِ أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلْإِلَهُ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, [for] the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell [among them].
verses.web: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
verses.he: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּרֹ֨ום ׀ שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנֹות בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף סֹ֝ורְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן ׀ יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ، يَوْمًا فَيَوْمًا يُحَمِّلُنَا إِلَهُ خَلَاصِنَا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] the Lord, [who] daily loadeth us [with benefits, even] the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
verses.he: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ יֹ֤ום ׀ יֹ֥ום יַֽעֲמָס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: ٱللهُ لَنَا إِلَهُ خَلَاصٍ، وَعِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلسَّيِّدِ لِلْمَوْتِ مَخَارِجُ.
verses.kjv: [He that is] our God [is] the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord [belong] the issues from death.
verses.web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
verses.he: הָ֤אֵ֣ל ׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמֹושָׁ֫עֹ֥ות וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תֹּוצָאֹֽות׃

verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ ٱللهَ يَسْحَقُ رُؤُوسَ أَعْدَائِهِ، ٱلْهَامَةَ ٱلشَّعْرَاءَ لِلسَّالِكِ فِي ذُنُوبِهِ.
verses.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, [and] the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
verses.he: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: «مِنْ بَاشَانَ أُرْجِعُ. أُرْجِعُ مِنْ أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْبَحْرِ،
verses.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [my people] again from the depths of the sea:
verses.web: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
verses.he: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻלֹ֥ות יָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَصْبغَ رِجْلَكَ بِٱلدَّمِ. أَلْسُنُ كِلَابِكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْدَاءِ نَصِيبُهُمْ».
verses.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of [thine] enemies, [and] the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.web: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
verses.he: לְמַ֤עַן ׀ תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשֹׁ֥ון כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: رَأَوْا طُرُقَكَ يَا ٱللهُ، طُرُقَ إِلَهِي مَلِكِي فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ.
verses.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; [even] the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.he: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכֹותֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכֹ֤ות אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: مِنْ قُدَّامٍ ٱلْمُغَنُّونَ. مِنْ وَرَاءٍ ضَارِبُو ٱلْأَوْتَارِ. فِي ٱلْوَسَطِ فَتَيَاتٌ ضَارِبَاتُ ٱلدُّفُوفِ.
verses.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments [followed] after; among [them were] the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.web: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
verses.he: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּתֹ֥וךְ עֲ֝לָמֹ֗ות תֹּופֵפֹֽות׃

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْجَمَاعَاتِ بَارِكُوا ٱللهَ ٱلرَّبَّ، أَيُّهَا ٱلْخَارِجُونَ مِنْ عَيْنِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, [even] the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.web: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
verses.he: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלֹות בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּקֹ֥ור יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: هُنَاكَ بِنْيَامِينُ ٱلصَّغِيرُ مُتَسَلِّطُهُمْ، رُؤَسَاءُ يَهُوذَا جُلُّهُمْ، رُؤَسَاءُ زَبُولُونَ، رُؤَسَاءُ نَفْتَالِي.
verses.kjv: There [is] little Benjamin [with] their ruler, the princes of Judah [and] their council, the princes of Zebulun, [and] the princes of Naphtali.
verses.web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.he: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן ׀ צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

verses.ar: قَدْ أَمَرَ إِلَهُكَ بِعِزِّكَ. أَيِّدْ يَا ٱللهُ هَذَا ٱلَّذِي فَعَلْتَهُ لَنَا.
verses.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
verses.he: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

verses.ar: مِنْ هَيْكَلِكَ فَوْقَ أُورُشَلِيمَ، لَكَ تُقَدِّمُ مُلُوكٌ هَدَايَا.
verses.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.web: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
verses.he: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְךָ֤ יֹובִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃

verses.ar: ٱنْتَهِرْ وَحْشَ ٱلْقَصَبِ، صِوَارَ ٱلثِّيرَانِ مَعَ عُجُولِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلْمُتَرَامِينَ بِقِطَعِ فِضَّةٍ. شَتِّتِ ٱلشُّعُوبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَرُّونَ بِٱلْقِتَالِ.
verses.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, [till every one] submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people [that] delight in war.
verses.web: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
verses.he: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים ׀ בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָבֹ֥ות יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃

verses.ar: يَأْتِي شُرَفَاءُ مِنْ مِصْرَ. كُوشُ تُسْرِعُ بِيَدَيْهَا إِلَى ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.web: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
verses.he: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: يَا مَمَالِكَ ٱلْأَرْضِ غَنُّوا لِلهِ. رَنِّمُوا لِلسَّيِّدِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
verses.he: מַמְלְכֹ֣ות הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: لِلرَّاكِبِ عَلَى سَمَاءِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ ٱلْقَدِيمَةِ. هُوَذَا يُعْطِي صَوْتَهُ صَوْتَ قُوَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, [which were] of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, [and that] a mighty voice.
verses.web: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.he: לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קֹולֹו קֹ֣ול עֹֽז׃

verses.ar: أَعْطُوا عِزًّا لِلهِ. عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ جَلَالُهُ، وَقُوَّتُهُ فِي ٱلْغَمَامِ.
verses.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency [is] over Israel, and his strength [is] in the clouds.
verses.web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
verses.he: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָתֹ֑ו וְ֝עֻזֹּ֗ו בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃

verses.ar: مَخُوفٌ أَنْتَ يَا ٱللهُ مِنْ مَقَادِسِكَ. إِلَهُ إِسْرَائِيلَ هُوَ ٱلْمُعْطِي قُوَّةً وَشِدَّةً لِلشَّعْبِ. مُبَارَكٌ ٱللهُ!
verses.kjv: O God, [thou art] terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel [is] he that giveth strength and power unto [his] people. Blessed [be] God.
verses.web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.he: נֹ֤ורָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן ׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמֹ֥ות לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
